purpose: One new-map check of the frozen formed candidate after the development comparison; no tuning or map selection from its game outcomes

decision.budget: 48 starts, 24 per subject; report separately from development
decision.selection: Selected before any policy game on this map, after tick-zero layout/load inspection: 120x120 world extent, two starts, same tracked-vehicle region, 56-node path. The other inspected custom map was unavailable locally, with its load error retained.
decision.condition: Run only if the frozen formed opening is retained after the larger development comparison; do not change its code or opponents for this check
decision.scope: Evidence for this additional map only. No new opponent family, human skill or formal D_target claim. Once its results guide changes it is an exposed development source.
decision.failure: Preserve losses, limits and errors. Keep the old default if a material regression remains unresolved; no repeated candidate adjustments against this check while still calling it unseen.
